properties.notes: Note the allocation assumes continued but consolidated education and community uses, with the introduction of complementary town centre uses, and some residential. The adjacent post office site which forms part of the same allocation has permission for 41 units. Further advice is set out in the Southall Opportunity Area Planning Framework (2014). Whilst an estimate of 5 is given for the minimum net number of dwellings, this is the size threshold for inclusion on the register, and where appropriate developments may need to exceed this in order to demonstrate that they have achieved an optimum level of development for the given site.. See allocation in Development Sites DPD (2013)
